text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: oncall (mia-ops) — Automated alert: spike in 5xxs and fallback routing across eu-west-1 reported. Estimated failed RPCs 22k/min, 80% routed to fallback-variant. Auto-pager sent.

mia-ops: I’m on it. Observing sudden increase in requests hitting model-variant `gptx-8b-quant-fallback` — looks like region policy forced fallback after a short capacity blip in eu-west-1.

sam-sre: Seeing client retry storms from a handful of high TPS customers. Their SDKs are doing exponential backoff but initial retry window is aggressive (50ms). Combined with server failover, requests doubled.

raj-ml: Confirmed: routing policy `smart-route-v2` has a misconfig where `max_failover_fanout` is 4 instead of 1 for region fallback. When primary degens, we concurrently spin 4 fallback paths per shard.

claire-support: We have two paying customers reporting degraded latency and 502s. CS ticket IDs: #CS-4871, #CS-4873. They’re asking if this is regional or model-related.

mia-ops: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) Pause smart-route automatic fallback in eu-west-1 (set `smart_route.enabled=false` for eu-west-1) 2) Apply emergency throttle on client retries at the ingress layer (`retry-window-ms` -> 200) 3) Start canary rollback of model variant to `gptx-8b-standby` for 2% traffic.

sam-sre: Executing throttle: `kubectl -n ingress patch configmap global-retries -p '{"data":{"retry-window-ms":"200"}}'` — patch applied. Observing inbound request rate drop ~35% in the last 30s.

deploy-bot: Rollout started: canary replace model variant `gptx-8b-quant-fallback` -> `gptx-8b-standby` (2% traffic) in eu-west-1.

raj-ml: I’m overriding the fallback policy: `set-policy smart-route-v2 --region eu-west-1 --max_failover_fanout 1 --force` — done. Should prevent parallel fanout.

kevin-backend: Added a temporary circuit-breaker at routing layer: `if backend_failures > 10/s then switch to queued-drop` to avoid thundering herd.

mia-ops: On-call handoff: @sam-sre — I need you to monitor error rate and confirm whether rollback reduces 5xx. I’m going to notify customers and coordinate postmortem.

sam-sre: Watching dashboard. 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 7% in 2m after throttle + policy change. Latency for affected flows improved but still ~250ms higher than baseline.

claire-support: Notifying customers with a short blurb: "We identified a fallback routing issue causing degraded latency and errors in EU. We’ve applied mitigations and continue to monitor. Will follow up with root cause and mitigation timeline."

raj-ml: Quick root cause summary so far: bad default in `smart-route-v2` caused multiple concurrent fallback attempts per request when a single shard reported degraded capacity; combined with aggressive client retries, this amplified traffic to fallback pool and overwhelmed the standby model variant leading to 503s.

mia-ops: Can we get a list of top client IPs / SDK keys causing retries? Sam, Kevin — please post a short query.

sam-sre: Query: `SELECT sdk_key, sum(requests) as rps FROM ingress_logs WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND ts > now()-5m GROUP BY sdk_key ORDER BY rps DESC LIMIT 10;` Top SDK keys attached — two customers responsible for ~45% of retry volume.

kevin-backend: Adding temporary per-SDK rate limits for the top offending keys: `rate-limit set --key <sdkA> --rps 500`, `--key <sdkB> --rps 400`. Applied. Immediate drop in retry noise.

mia-ops: @raj-ml can you check model health on the fallback pool — any OOMs/queue saturation?

raj-ml: Checking model logs: a few OOM spikes and long event loop latencies on the quantized fallback instances. Queue depth hit >200 for several seconds. We’re scaling the fallback pool but it’s cascading because new replicas are also getting hot due to fanout until we throttled.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback to `gptx-8b-standby` at 2% shows improved success ratio for that shard. Proceeding to ramp to 25% over 5m if 5xx stays <5%.

sam-sre: 5xx stabilized around 3.8% after policy and throttles. Ramping up standby variant to 25% now. Observe CPU on standby nodes—utilization up but within margin.

claire-support: Customer update sent: "Mitigations applied: routing policy tightened, client retry throttles, fallback rollback. We expect normal service to resume; please reach out if you still see errors."

mia-ops: Incident severity: S2 -> keep pager until fully normalized and postmortem assigned. Postmortem owners: raj-ml (root cause), sam-sre (mitigation timeline + monitoring gaps), kevin-backend (ingress retry controls).

raj-ml: Postmortem notes draft: bullet points for RCA, timeline, config diff (policy change), and action items: 1) revert default fanout to 1 2) add unit tests for fallback policy 3) add canary-limit on fallback ramp 4) default client SDK backoff minimum to 200ms 5) better per-SDK emergency throttles.

sam-sre: Action item: Add an automated circuit-breaker that detects simultaneous multi-path fanout >2 and pauses new failovers for 30s. Filing infra ticket INF-6523.

mia-ops: Thanks all. Keeping channel open for final confirmation once all metrics show steady-state for 15m. If anything changes, escalate. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident incident-2026-03-15-2143658700 created. Pager still active.
